beats.composition_summary: Wide illustrated airplane cabin viewed down a central aisle. A white-wigged scholar character stands in the lower-left foreground, many passengers sit in rows on both sides, and a small jagged blue opening is visible in the distant rear door. Curved blue and green streaks and several loose fragments occupy the upper-right side of the cabin.

targets.label: white-wigged scholar character
targets.visible_evidence: White curled wig, black robe and white neck cloth; full standing figure at lower left.

targets.label: scholar character face
targets.visible_evidence: Orange face with two wide open eyes and long nose inside the white wig; eyes point toward screen right.

targets.label: scholar character hanging hand
targets.visible_evidence: Small orange hand visible below the left sleeve at the character's side.

targets.label: jagged blue opening in rear door
targets.visible_evidence: Small blue rear-door opening with irregular dark jagged edge.

targets.label: blue and green curved cabin streaks
targets.visible_evidence: Multiple curved blue and green lines spread from the rear opening across the right ceiling and wall.

targets.label: small loose fragments in streaks
targets.visible_evidence: Several small tan, white and dark scraps are drawn suspended among the colored streaks.

targets.label: foreground right seated passenger
targets.visible_evidence: Large seated figure at lower right wearing a pale green top and brown trousers.

targets.label: foreground right passenger face
targets.visible_evidence: Face above the right foreground seatback with eyes closed and head angled slightly down.

targets.label: left-side seated passenger face
targets.visible_evidence: Dark-haired face visible above a left-side seatback, eyes closed.

targets.label: center-left seated passenger face
targets.visible_evidence: Light-haired face visible above a center-left seatback, eyes closed.

targets.label: rows of seated passengers
targets.visible_evidence: Multiple occupied seat rows line both sides of the aisle behind the foreground figures.

targets.label: central cabin aisle
targets.visible_evidence: Brown aisle runs from the lower foreground toward the rear door.

beats.notes: Keep the lower-left scholar and the small rear opening visible together for the depth contrast. Preserve the right-side colored streaks and loose fragments. The lowest paper margin is visually blank.

beats.composition_summary: Medium illustrated airplane-cabin view centered on a seated passenger with a distressed facial expression and both hands pressed high on the chest. Blue-green curved strokes cross the cabin around the figure. Several yellow-orange oxygen-mask-like objects hang from overhead panels, with seats and windows receding into the background.

targets.visible_evidence: Seated figure near center with hunched shoulders and both hands raised to the upper chest.

targets.label: distressed passenger face
targets.visible_evidence: Wide eyes, raised brows and open mouth are visibly drawn on the central passenger's face; gaze is roughly forward.

targets.label: both hands pressed to chest
targets.visible_evidence: Two visible hands overlap the upper chest directly below the face.

targets.label: hanging yellow-orange mask objects
targets.visible_evidence: Several yellow-orange cup-shaped objects with pale tubes hang from overhead fixtures.

targets.label: blue-green curved cabin streaks
targets.visible_evidence: Broad pale blue and green curved lines sweep behind and around the seated passenger.

targets.label: large overhead storage bin

targets.label: surrounding airplane seats
targets.visible_evidence: Seatbacks and armrests surround the central passenger and continue into the rear-right background.

beats.notes: Prioritize the central face and both chest-clutching hands. Preserve the hanging mask objects across the upper-right area. The lower-center/right blue floor area is the clearest low-detail negative space; no separate blank caption panel is visible.
